name: Cedar Hollow Property Group
html:
Cedar Hollow Property Group

We are a family-run team managing single-family homes and duplexes across Wake County since 2009.

For Residents

Rent is due on the 1st. We accept rent by personal check or money order at our office, or you can drop it in our after-hours box.

For Owners

Owners receive a printed statement by mail along with their payout check by the 15th of each month.

Careers

We're hiring a part-time bookkeeper to help with owner payouts and vendor bills. Experience with QuickBooks a plus. Apply by email.

mock_score.reason: They take rent by check, mail printed owner statements with payout checks, and are hiring a part-time bookkeeper for payouts and bills.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Owners receive a printed statement by mail along with their payout check by the 15th of each month.

name: Riverbend Residential
html:
Riverbend Residential

Locally owned and operated, Riverbend Residential manages over 140 homes and townhomes in Durham and Chapel Hill.

Our office manager reconciles every owner account by hand at the end of each month so nothing slips through the cracks.

Residents can pay rent online through our portal or by check. Owner statements are emailed as PDFs.

Call us today for a free rental analysis.

mock_score.reason: An office manager reconciles every owner account by hand at month end, though residents can pay online.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Our office manager reconciles every owner account by hand at the end of each month so nothing slips through the cracks.

name: Willow Creek Property Management
html:
Willow Creek Property Management

A small, family-owned company serving Cary, Apex, and Morrisville.

We keep a detailed spreadsheet for every property so owners always know where their money went.

Owner portal coming soon. In the meantime, statements are emailed monthly.

Maintenance requests can be submitted by phone or email.

mock_score.reason: They track each property in a spreadsheet and email statements while an owner portal is still coming.
mock_score.evidence_quote: We keep a detailed spreadsheet for every property so owners always know where their money went.

name: Lantern Property Partners
html:
Lantern Property Partners

Student and faculty rentals near campus, managed with a personal touch.

Each August our two-person office processes move-ins, security deposits, and owner distributions for the new lease year.

Rent may be paid by check, money order, or bank transfer.

mock_score.reason: A two-person office handles deposits and owner distributions, and rent comes in by check or money order.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Each August our two-person office processes move-ins, security deposits, and owner distributions for the new lease year.

name: Bluebird Property Co.
html:
Bluebird Property Co.

Full-service management for 85 single-family rentals in Raleigh and Garner.

Residents pay rent online through our Buildium resident portal.

Owner statements are posted to the owner portal by the 10th, and our accountant reviews each one before payouts go out.

mock_score.reason: They use Buildium and an owner portal, but an accountant still reviews each statement by hand before payouts.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Owner statements are posted to the owner portal by the 10th, and our accountant reviews each one before payouts go out.

name: Maple & Main Rentals
html:
Maple & Main Rentals

We proudly manage 260 doors across northern Wake County.

Residents can pay rent online, submit maintenance requests, and sign leases electronically through AppFolio.

Owners get 24/7 access to statements and year-end tax documents in the owner portal.

mock_score.reason: They run on AppFolio with online rent, e-signed leases, and a self-serve owner portal.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Owners get 24/7 access to statements and year-end tax documents in the owner portal.

name: Oakline Homes
html:
Oakline Homes

Professionally managing 1,200 apartments across the Triangle.

Apply, pay rent, and request service anytime on RentCafe, powered by Yardi.

Our dedicated accounting department and regional controllers deliver institutional-grade reporting to every investor.

mock_score.reason: Large operator on Yardi with a dedicated accounting department and institutional reporting.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Our dedicated accounting department and regional controllers deliver institutional-grade reporting to every investor.

name: Stonegate Realty & Rentals
html:
Stonegate Realty & Rentals

Buying, selling, and renting homes in Garner and Clayton for over twenty years.

Our rental division handles tenant screening, leasing, maintenance, and monthly reporting for local investors.

Contact our office to learn more about our management plans.

mock_score.reason: Small realty office whose rental division handles all reporting in-house.
mock_score.evidence_quote: Our rental team does all the owner bookkeeping by hand every month.
